name: glance
description: A HUD under the Claude Code prompt: model, git, cost, context and rate-limit bars, tools, skills, MCP, agents and todos at a glance

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: auto: Cupertino (iOS system colours), light or dark with the Claude Code theme; catppuccin: latte or mocha the same way; or one Catppuccin flavor

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: Cells in each of the ctx, 5h and 7d bars (4 to 30)

warnAt.title: Warn at %
warnAt.description: A bar and its figure turn red at this percentage

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: The session's cost as /cost totals it

showDuration.title: Show duration
showDuration.description: How long the session has run

showTools.title: Show tools
showTools.description: Running tools and the session's tool counts

showSkills.title: Show skills and MCP
showSkills.description: Skills loaded and MCP servers called

keepHint.title: Keep the hint line
keepHint.description: Draw Claude Code's own hint line (? for shortcuts, esc to interrupt) under the HUD
